population_definitions.full_screened: All combined records evaluated by the deterministic screen
population_definitions.exact_text_unique_sensitivity: One deterministic representative per combined-text SHA-256 value; sensitivity population only

interpretation_boundaries: The exact-text-unique population is a duplicate sensitivity population, not a final eligible population.
Co-occurrence and lift are descriptive of captured records and do not establish direction, sequence, common actors, transactions, or causation.
AML candidates are corpus-derived research hypotheses, not confirmed red flags or monitoring controls.
Service-chain stages are an exploratory descriptive grouping and do not establish a completed service chain.
